changes: Power-curve polynomial is standardized to 5th order for CHC C4, CHC C6, BFI and ES in KeySuite and KeyBot
Legacy display-only cubic Power smoothing is bypassed so the visible Power curve follows the 5th-order polynomial directly
All plotted pump/system/orifice/parallel/variable curve lines in KeySuite PDF output use 1.8 SVG units while on-screen line thickness remains unchanged
All plotted curve lines in KeyBot PDF output use 1.35 pt, approximately the visual equivalent of 1.8 px
ES motor-trimmed curve display removes invalid trailing zero hydraulic points so Head, Efficiency, Power and NPSH no longer drop vertically to zero at the high-flow endpoint
ES motor + flow-only Fast Search preserves the user-entered flow unit and adds the converted m³/hr value; derived head is displayed rounded to the nearest whole metre
Example: 500 IGPM is displayed as 500 IGPM (136.4 m³/hr) @ 103 mtr while exact internal flow/head values remain in calculations
notes: Upgrade from V4.28.09. Upload the V4.28.10 web files to GitHub and redeploy telegram-webhook. No database migration is required.
